ELESIS-VITALITY.title: Vitality
ELESIS-VITALITY.description:
Vitality cards build Chivalry.
When a Vitality card causes Elesis to reach 5 Chivalry, she spends 5 Chivalry and draws 1 card.
ELESIS-DESTRUCTION.title: Destruction
ELESIS-DESTRUCTION.description:
Destruction cards spend 5 Chivalry for an immediate bonus.
Attacks gain +8 damage.
Attack-block cards also gain +5 Block.
ELESIS-FLAME.title: Flame
ELESIS-FLAME.description:
Flame cards add Flame to Elesis.
Non-Flame attacks consume all Flame to deal that much extra damage.
ELESIS-PARRY.title: Parry
ELESIS-PARRY.description:
Parry cards are defensive knight techniques.
They currently gain Chivalry while protecting Elesis.
ELESIS-CHIVALRY.title: Chivalry
ELESIS-CHIVALRY.description:
Chivalry is Elesis' stance rhythm.
Vitality cards can spend 5 Chivalry to draw 1 card.
Destruction cards can spend 5 Chivalry for bonus damage or Block.
